_comment: The lab rig with graspion_tracking's interim v4 (calib_2026-11-12_interim_v4/README.txt; in progress, the 1 mm gates miss narrowly). Reference markers: the 8 arena markers flat on the plate at the view's edges, from arena.json. Arena: where the robot's centre stays 31 mm clear of the marker papers (x 86..860 mm, y 87..633 mm, as arena_extent_v4.py gives). Camera: Basler through pypylon, the fixed view 2700 x 2064 at (192, 0), 20 ms, 5 dB (also saved in the camera as UserSet1); the tracker kept up with all ~50 fps in a 10 s check on 2026-11-12. camera_height_m is only a fallback, since the pose comes from K and the markers. Bot: '90' is only the label run --bot uses (ir_drive_rx has no calib_bot IR ID; the remote addresses slot 63); marker_height is the tag face above the plate (22.9 mm from the STLs: replace with the ruler reading); led_offset null because the tag covers the sync LED. Bridge: the teammate's ir_remote_tx on W10nY (COM5) driving a robot that runs ir_drive_rx; slot 63 reaches every robot in IR range.

90.reference_point: marker centre (set marker_offset to use the body centre)
